SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Pick an actual lodge, launch or guide before arranging onward transport. This regional brief is not a chart of fishable water; ask for the intended species, tackle provision and alternative fishing plan before committing to specialized gear.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for British Columbia

Visitors aged 16 and older need a provincial freshwater licence. Tidal waters require a separate federal licence at every age.

  • April 1 to March 31$62.87 CAD
  • April 1 to March 31$91.44 CAD
  • 1 day$22.86 CAD
  • 8 days$41.15 CAD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Tidal salmon conservation stamp ↗ · $7.39 CAD
    Every angler who keeps salmon from tidal water. Add the stamp to the federal tidal fishing licence.

Rules for this water

  • For tidal salmon, use barbless single-point hooks; the maximum hook gap is 22 mm from September 1, 2026.
  • Check DFO tidal area maps, species limits and closed areas for the exact fishing position official regulations ↗
